capabilities.name: Long-form song
capabilities.criterion: 64-bar, 8-section piece with a hard ending in one file; renders with the correct section boundaries

capabilities.name: Buses, send, sidechain
capabilities.criterion: 4 buses, one send, one ducked bus; ducking depth >= 6 dB measured on the output

capabilities.name: Automation precision
capabilities.criterion: Parameter ramp timing error < 1 ms at 48 kHz

capabilities.name: Offline render
capabilities.criterion: Reference song renders to WAV: non-silent, correct length, byte-identical across two runs

capabilities.name: Stems
capabilities.criterion: One WAV per bus; the stems sum to the mix within -60 dBFS residual

capabilities.name: Voice capacity
capabilities.criterion: Sustained polyphony for 60 s with 0 late starts (Browser >= 64, Desktop >= 256 voices); CLI renders the reference song >= 4x real time

capabilities.name: Safe live swap
capabilities.criterion: A failing evaluation mid-playback causes no audio gap > 128 frames; the previous pattern continues

capabilities.name: Headphone cue
capabilities.criterion: A pattern can be routed to a second output device, inaudible on the main output

capabilities.name: Third-party plugin
capabilities.criterion: Load a CLAP or VST3 instrument, play notes from a pattern, capture non-silent output

capabilities.name: External clock
capabilities.criterion: MIDI clock-out jitter < 2 ms over 60 s

capabilities.name: Microtonal
capabilities.criterion: 19-EDO and a just-intonation scale usable in pattern code; pitches within +-1 cent

capabilities.name: Error quality
capabilities.criterion: A syntax error and an unknown function each report the exact line and column

capabilities.name: Tier builds
capabilities.criterion: The tier builds from a clean checkout with the documented toolchain
